TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING AGENDA
  THURSDAY JULY 20, 2023 9:30 AM
  SAN DIMAS COUNCIL CHAMBER CONFERENCE ROOM
  245 EAST BONITA AVENUE

PLEASE NOTE: Traffic Safety Committee is an Advisory Committee which is open to the public. In order to conduct the
meeting effectively and fairly, participants will be given an opportunity to discuss their concerns within a 3-minute time
allotment. This timing has been instituted to ensure everyone wishing to speak has the same opportunity. We appreciate
your understanding and cooperation with this policy.

If you have any additional questions, please contact staff at (909) 394-6240 or email at publicworks@sandimasca.gov.

INTRODUCTIONS

DISCUSSION ITEMS

#07-23-01 BASELINE LN AT WEHNER LN
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review for line of sight concerns exiting Wehner Ln. (GoGov#2023-0837).

#07-23-02 AVENIDA LOMITA AT CALLE SERRA
REQUEST FROM RESIDENT, to review and consider installation of speed humps on Avenida Lomita to deter
speeding.

#07-23-03  GLADSTONE ST AND BELLEVIEW AVE INTERSECTION
REQUEST FROM RESIDENT, to review and consider installation of red curb on s/w corner to assist with
perceived line of sight concern for vehicles exiting Belleview.

#07-23-04  CODY RD AND CHAPARRAL RD
REQUEST FROM RESIDENT, to review and consider installation of stops signs at the new corners of Cody
Rd extension to assist with near miss collisions due to vehicles not stopping at this intersection.

#07-23-05  1st ST AND CITY HALL PARKING LOT (HALLOWEEN SPOOKTACULAR 2023)
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review traffic control plans for the City’s Halloween Spooktakular event
scheduled for Saturday, October 23, 2023. Event temporarily closes 1st St and City Hall Parking lot from
2:00pm-10:00pm.

#07-23-06  BONITA AVE (BETWEEN SAN DIMAS & CATARACT) (HOLIDAY EXTRAVAGANZA 2023)
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review traffic control plans for the City’s Holiday Extravaganza event scheduled
for Saturday, December 2, 2023. Event temporarily closes Bonita Ave between San Dimas Ave and Cataract
from Friday, December 1st thru Sunday, December 3rd, 6:00am. Also, to review Parade traffic control plan
which temporarily closes Bonita, 1st, 2nd, San Dimas, Monte Vista and Cataract from 4:30-5:30pm.

#07-23-07  JUANITA AVE AND BASILIO AVE INTERSECTION
 Traffic Safety Committee Agenda
For the Meeting of July 20, 2023  Page 2

REQUEST FROM RESIDENT, to review and consider installation of 3 way stop signs to assist with perceived
speeding on Juanita Ave. Resident also indicates that during school hours and baseball games the numerous
parked cars cause line of sight concerns for pedestrians crossing Juanita Ave.

#07-23-08  EUCLA AVE AND 4TH ST INTERSECTION
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review intersection for possible enhancements as a result of concern submitted
via anonymous GoGov item which requests consideration for visible stop signs, fixing faded striping or a 4 way
stop. (GoGov #2023-0964).

#07-23-09  1st ST AND CITY HALL PARKING LOT (CITY BIRTHDAY 2023)
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review traffic control plans for the City Birthday event scheduled for Saturday,
August 5, 2023. Event temporarily closes 1st St and City Hall Parking lot from 2:00pm-11:00pm.

#07-23-10  SDHS HOMECOMING PARADE 2023
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review traffic control plans for the San Dimas High School’s Homecoming Parade
event scheduled for Friday, September 22, 2023. Committee to review previous parade route and suggested
alternatives. Parade will temporarily close streets from 2:00pm-4:20pm.

#07-23-11 GOLD LINE WAY FINDING SINAGE
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review the Gold Line’s submittal for way finding signage.

CONTINUED ITEMS

#06-23-04  MAVERICK DR AND BUTTERFIELD AVE
REQUEST FROM RESIDENT, to review and consider creation and implementation of permit parking district for the
Maverick Dr and Butterfield Ave area residents.

#06-23-08  BONITA AVE, SAN DIMAS AVE, GLADSTONE ST (RUNNIN SCARED 5K 2023)
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review traffic control plans for the City’s Runnin’ Scared 5k event scheduled for Saturday,
September 30, 2023. Event temporarily closes portions of Bonita Ave, San Dimas Ave, Gladstone, Iglesia St, 5th St, and
San Dimas Canyon Rd from 5:30am-11:30pm.

#06-23-09  1st ST (NATIONAL NIGHT OUT 2023)
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review sight and traffic control plans for the Sheriff’s National Night Out event scheduled for
Tuesday, August 1, 2023. Event temporarily is scheduled from 4:00pm-8:00pm and will follow portions of the approved
Farmer’s Market traffic control plans.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT
 Traffic Safety Committee Agenda
For the Meeting of July 20, 2023  Page 3

  Notice Regarding Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need assistance
  to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (909) 394-6216. Early notification
  before the meeting you wish to attend will make it possible for the City to make reasonable arrangements
  to ensure accessibility to this meeting [28 CFR 35.102-35.104 ADA Title II].
Copies of documents distributed for the meeting are available in alternative formats upon request. Any writings or
documents provided to the Traffic Safety Committee regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for
public review Monday through Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. and on Fridays from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at the Public
Works Department. In addition, most documents are posted on the City’s website at www.sandimasca.gov.

Posting Statement: I declare under penalty of perjury that on July 13th, 2023, I posted a true and correct copy of this
agenda on the bulletin board in the Civic Center Plaza of City Hall at 245 E. Bonita Ave., and on the City’s
website www.sandimasca.gov/agendas-minutes/ as required by law.

  Rhonda Abangan
July 13, 2023  Rhonda Abangan, Administrative Secretary
